answer: Reciprocity weight unlocks only after 30 days of uninterrupted uptime, and one missed epoch at the boundary halves it. An echo of mutual signatures between two addresses counts once when both share an operator. Run 200 clones that attest each other daily and build weight, then a single beacon of linked registrations exposes the cluster and resets all 200. Rebuilding needs 30 clean days per key, so the farm spends 6,000 key-days before a crystal of full-weight votes exists again.
